items.english: Find the shortest distance between two lines that neither intersect nor are parallel, i.e. their common perpendicular.

von Kirchhoff
items.english: Furthermore, the problem of finding the electric (natural) charge distribution on arbitrarily many spheres in space (respectively circles in the plane) always leads to a system of functional equations, by Kirchhoff's method.
